paragraphs: The early shift begins with an inventory and handoff. During the day, accept mail at the counter, enter orders into the system, sort, and dispatch items. At midday, handle inquiries and address changes. In the afternoon, deliver items and collect signatures. Before leaving, reconcile accounts, archive records, and prepare for the next day.

In one sentence: ensure mail reaches its destination reliably. The work includes acceptance, sorting, delivery, inquiries, address changes, and archiving. It combines hands-on work with problem-solving and serves on the front line of universal service.
